map.CRn（Concentration Ratio）指行业内前 n 家企业的份额之和: CRn (Concentration Ratio) is the summed share of the top n companies in an industry and measures concentration. A CR3 of 81% means the top three control 80% of the market, so it is hard for a new entrant to break through and differentiation or a niche route is the way to go.

map.竞品分析在线工具，输入份额与定位等多维数据评估竞争优势与差距，辅助市场策略制定，: Online competitor analysis tool: enter multi-dimensional data such as share and positioning to assess competitive advantage and gaps, supporting market strategy, with batch data support. Runs entirely in the front end.
map.通常因只录入了主要竞品、遗漏长尾，或数据口径不一致。可先补全省市/渠道全量再算，: This is usually because only the main competitors were entered and the long tail was missed, or because the data definitions differ. You can first fill in the complete set across all cities and channels, or tick 'normalise by the entered values' and let the tool convert them into shares. Any conclusion presumes the data source is complete and consistently defined.
map.：录入份额：35, 28, 18, 12, 7（%）。合计 100%；排序后头部: : Entering the shares 35, 28, 18, 12, 7 (%) gives a total of 100%; the top three after sorting are 35+28+18=81%, so CR3=81% and the market is highly concentrated. The largest competitor holds 35%; if you are at 18% you are in the second tier.
